annotations.title: Table of contents of an EU act

description: WHAT IS IN THIS EU ACT — its table of contents: the titles, chapters and sections, each with the range of articles it holds. The EU twin of get_act_structure. Use it when you need an article of a long act but do not know its number — guessing an article number is how a citation gets fabricated. Pass `part` with a division's name (e.g. 'TITLUL VIII' or 'Secțiunea 2') to list that division's articles with their opening words; EU articles carry no headings, so the opening words are what tell them apart. Then use lookup_eu_article for the text of the one you want.

part.description: Optional. One division to open, e.g. 'TITLUL VIII'. Matched diacritic-insensitively against the division names; English level names and either kind of numeral work too ('CHAPTER II', 'Chapter 2', 'Annex III').

name: get_eu_act_structure
